body:
> I've started a jekyll website based with the content of @bobylito's documentation

I wonder, where was this content before because I missed it? In a branch or something?

> We'll probably host it on https://community.algolia.com/instant-search/ or something similar.

What will be the difference with the https://github.com/algolia/instant-search-demo? Seems confusing names (yes we can change them).

I think what I miss is where will we advertise/guide our users towards either:
- github/website? widgets jsdoc
- live documentation website
- algolia.com documentation on instantsearch.js
- instant search demo website and github and tutorial

This seems many different ways to document and not sure how we will handle this and how to present things so that it makes sense for our users and they are not lost.

> built-in search :) (cc @pixelastic)

What will be the use of the built-in search for the live documentation website?

> Why Jekyll?

Not against it, if it's easy to push updates and nice for our users that's it.
